review:
Wild West Gold is a 5×4 Western slot that has stayed popular for its sticky multiplier wilds. In the base game, wilds come with 2x, 3x or 5x multipliers, added together when more than one is part of a win.

Three scatters trigger eight free spins, and two to five scatters during the round add four to 20 more. In the bonus every multiplier wild is sticky, so wilds build up across the reels for the rest of the feature. Pragmatic lists a 96.51% RTP. It suits players who like a simple bonus that can snowball.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
